title: Jericho’s Inner Circle vs. Jon Moxley
summary: AEW’s first world champion builds a faction around his reign before Moxley brings it to an end.

chapters.title: AEW crowns its first world champion
chapters.result: Jericho defeats Adam Page for the inaugural championship.
chapters.context: The title establishes Jericho as the obstacle for AEW’s challengers.

chapters.title: Moxley dethrones Le Champion
chapters.result: Moxley defeats Jericho for the AEW World Championship.
chapters.context: Moxley overcomes the champion at the end of their title pursuit.
